title.en: Make Guru voice turns send and speak automatically
title.zh: 让智能导师语音轮次自动发送并朗读

purpose.en: Turn SmartLingo's existing text-and-microphone composer into a reliable conversational loop: typed messages remain silent text chat, while a microphone turn shows its transcript, sends one final result automatically, clears the submitted draft, and reads the visible AI reply aloud.
purpose.zh: 将 SmartLingo 现有文字与麦克风编辑框升级为可靠的对话闭环：键盘消息继续作为静音文字聊天；麦克风轮次会显示转写、仅自动发送一次最终结果、清除已提交草稿，并朗读屏幕上可见的 AI 回答。

en: Keep typed chat explicit and silent: the learner types, selects Send, sees the text reply, and may still use the existing manual read-aloud control.
Show interim microphone transcription in the composer, automatically submit exactly one non-empty final transcript, and immediately move that submitted text into the visible conversation.
Keep the composer empty after an accepted send and after the AI reply without deleting a genuinely new draft typed while the answer is pending.
Automatically read an AI reply only when its request came from a microphone turn, while always displaying the same reply as text and preserving pause, resume, and stop controls.
zh: 保留明确且静音的键盘聊天：学习者输入后点击发送、查看文字回答，并可继续使用原有手动朗读控件。
在编辑框中显示麦克风临时转写，仅自动提交一次非空最终转写，并立即把已提交文字移入可见对话。
接受发送后及 AI 回答到达后保持编辑框为空，同时不会删除等待回答期间真正新输入的草稿。
仅当请求来自麦克风轮次时自动朗读 AI 回答；同一回答始终同步显示为文字，并保留暂停、继续和停止控件。

en: The localized /{lang}/assistant experience, including the Leo partner path /zh/assistant?language=en&mode=conversation&partner=leo, the assistant voice-turn controller, production route checks, and Project release evidence.
No D1 schema, stored learning content, membership, payment, classroom, AI-provider selection, or other site is changed by this release.
zh: 涉及本地化 /{lang}/assistant 体验，包括 Leo 伙伴路径 /zh/assistant?language=en&mode=conversation&partner=leo、助手语音轮次控制器、生产路由检查及 Project 发布证据。
本次不修改 D1 结构、已存学习内容、会员、付款、课程教室、AI 提供方选择或其他站点。

en: Track typed and voice request origins per submitted turn so a later typed message can never inherit automatic speech from a prior microphone turn.
Use a one-shot recognition lifecycle with final-result consumption, in-flight protection, and detached terminal handlers so one utterance cannot send twice or repopulate a cleared composer.
Track user draft revisions independently from programmatic transcript updates so answer completion clears only the submitted draft and preserves newer learner input.
Preserve SmartLingo's image attachment path, AI-partner disclosure and prompt, target-language speech locale, public typed assistant, and Clerk sign-in requirement for microphone access.
zh: 按每次提交分别记录键盘或语音来源，确保之后的键盘消息绝不会继承前一个麦克风轮次的自动朗读。
采用单次识别生命周期、最终结果消费、请求中保护及终态回调解绑，避免同一句话重复发送或把已清空编辑框重新填回。
把用户草稿修订与程序写入的转写分开记录，使回答完成时只清除已提交草稿并保留学习者的新输入。
保留 SmartLingo 图片附件、AI 伙伴身份披露与提示、目标语言 speechLocale、公开文字助手，以及麦克风访问的 Clerk 登录要求。

en: Require behavior-focused voice-turn tests for interim display, one final submission, duplicate and late-event suppression, submitted-draft clearing, preservation of newer drafts, visible AI text, voice-only automatic speech, typed silence, and unsupported-browser fallback.

Require zero-warning lint, TypeScript checking, the verified production build and artifact checks, the repository's selected identity, classroom, payment, voice, release, and deployment contracts, D1 validation, and shared site gates.

Probe the production Chinese Leo partner URL and its AI disclosure before writing the Project record, then require post-deploy real-Chrome acceptance with injected recognition and synthesis events for the changed interaction.
zh: 要求面向行为的语音轮次测试覆盖：临时转写显示、一次最终提交、重复与迟到事件抑制、已提交草稿清除、新草稿保留、AI 文字可见、仅语音来源自动朗读、键盘静音及不支持浏览器的降级。
要求零告警 lint、TypeScript 检查、经验证的生产构建与产物检查、仓库选定的身份、课程教室、付款、语音、发布和部署合同、D1 校验及共享站点门禁通过。
在写入 Project 记录前探测生产中文 Leo 伙伴 URL 及 AI 身份披露，并在部署后以真实 Chrome 注入识别和朗读事件验收本次交互。

en: No physical production microphone is opened and no audible device speech is played during deterministic injected-event acceptance; actual recognition quality, installed voices, permission prompts, connectivity, and background behavior remain browser and operating-system dependent.
No production camera or multi-party realtime audio/video session is started.
zh: 确定性注入事件验收不会打开生产设备的实体麦克风，也不会实际播放有声设备朗读；真实识别质量、已安装语音、权限提示、联网及后台行为仍取决于浏览器与操作系统。
本次不启动生产摄像头或多人实时音视频会话。

en: Keep text Ask Guru and AI partners public while requiring the existing Clerk member session before the microphone starts; preserve the selected interface language and the target language's speechLocale independently.

Keep Mika, Leo, and Aya clearly disclosed as AI study partners, preserve partner-specific conversation prompts and image attachments, and verify the Chinese-interface English-practice Leo route used in the reported iPad flow.
zh: 继续公开提供文字智能导师与 AI 学习伙伴，同时沿用现有 Clerk 会员会话门槛后才启动麦克风；界面语言与目标语言 speechLocale 继续分别保留。
继续明确披露 Mika、Leo 与 Aya 为 AI 学习伙伴，保留伙伴专属会话提示及图片附件，并核验本次 iPad 反馈所使用的中文界面、英语练习 Leo 路径。
